name: ABS Marine Services Limited
summary: Asset-backed charter expansion has produced substantial growth, but owner returns depend on vessel replacement, debt amortization and counterparty cash collection. BQS5.64 and Growth Quality GQS6.65, corrected for the short consolidated history. At the verified ₹281.45 close on 19 October, the corrected conditional model implies 7.68% base and 24.10% bull five-year returns, before personal taxes and after assumed 1% entry/exit friction. Neither meets a claim of certainty. Conditional IAS3.51, unranked while the conditional financing bridge remains unresolved; severe stress is unfunded. This is a deep financial review with an unresolved implementation gate, not an attractive-entry designation. Model corrected on 20 October 2026 for opening obligations and retained terminal claims; historical financial figures are unchanged.
identity_note: ISIN/SME and24.55million shares confirmed in16October share reconciliation and19October exchange bhavcopy.
score_note: Conditional IAS3.51; downside evidence Medium supports D2 adverse funding-path assessment, not predicted bankruptcy or quantified recovery. Excluded from implementation ranking while G3 conditional financing remains unresolved.

GOV.reason: Unmodified opinions and affirmative audit-trail reporting coexist with material reporting inconsistencies. July clarification adds positive minority profit, while the later annual correctly subtracts it. Cash-flow presentation includes bank financing, and the contingent-guarantee subtotal does not add. Oceandeep is outside the statutory group and related charter economics remain incompletely reconciled. These concerns do not establish intent or diversion. [S26](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/annual_reports/SME_AR_30522_ABSMARINE_2025_2026_A_4942091_22082026195020.pdf) [S25](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/annual_reports/SME_AR_27749_ABSMARINE_2024_2025_A_5789022_26082025205957.pdf) [SCLARIFY](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/ABSMARINE_17072026184933_ReplytoNSEforresubmissionoffinancialresultsconsolidatedXBRL.pdf) [SCALL](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/ABSMARINE_08062026131212_Intimationontranscriptofmeeting.pdf)
GOV.contrary_evidence: Unmodified audit is favorable counterevidence; reporting errors do not prove intentional diversion.

CAP.reason: Normalized company-level incremental NOPAT proxy 18.0% falls to 16.2% with₹45 cr economic depreciation. Constant 25–35% margins yield weaker returns. Pricing, tax change and new fleet utilization confound attribution to new capital; mixed economics around/beyond the 12–16% cost range support 5, not a high-return extrapolation. [S24](https://absmarine.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/ABS-Annual-Report-2024.pdf) [S26](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/annual_reports/SME_AR_30522_ABSMARINE_2025_2026_A_4942091_22082026195020.pdf) [SCALL](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/ABSMARINE_08062026131212_Intimationontranscriptofmeeting.pdf)
CAP.contrary_evidence: Normalized incremental return 18.0% looks strong but constant-margin returns 9.45–13.23% may not exceed assumed 12–16% cost.

BAL.reason: Borrowings rise to₹377.22 cr versus common equity₹311.08 cr. Mortgage, receivable escrow and liens limit liquidity flexibility. Internal guarantees reconcile to debt already consolidated and are not added again. The normal model is funded under explicit post-March acquisition/loan bounds, but a severe utilization/collection stress is not. [S26](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/annual_reports/SME_AR_30522_ABSMARINE_2025_2026_A_4942091_22082026195020.pdf) [SCRA](https://www.crisil.com/mnt/winshare/Ratings/RatingList/RatingDocs/ABSMarineServicesLimited_June%2024_%202026_RR_398742.html)
BAL.contrary_evidence: CRISIL upgrade is favorable but covers a broader group; it does not eliminate listed-group debt and stress shortfall.

MOAT.reason: Specialized vessels, regulatory qualification and charter relationships support switching friction. Tender competition, charter-rate cyclicality and concentrated counterparties prevent an assumption of permanent pricing power. The current profit mix is increasingly asset-intensive vessel ownership rather than only management fees. [S26](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/annual_reports/SME_AR_30522_ABSMARINE_2025_2026_A_4942091_22082026195020.pdf) [SCONTRACT](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/ABSMARINE_19062026165449_Intimationfornewcontract.pdf)
MOAT.contrary_evidence: Concentrated customers and tender renewals limit sustained pricing power despite technical qualifications.

DUR.reason: Several multi-year charters provide near-term visibility. Artemis has a five-year firm contract, but extension options belong to the charterer. Offshore spending, vessel availability, renewal rates and ageing assets remain cyclical; long contracts do not eliminate maintenance or debt service. [S26](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/annual_reports/SME_AR_30522_ABSMARINE_2025_2026_A_4942091_22082026195020.pdf) [SCONTRACT](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/ABSMARINE_19062026165449_Intimationfornewcontract.pdf) [SCALL](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/ABSMARINE_08062026131212_Intimationontranscriptofmeeting.pdf)
DUR.contrary_evidence: Charterer-controlled extension options and dry-dock/off-hire risk prevent treating the visible term as perpetual.

EXEC.reason: Fleet purchases and the Artemis charter demonstrate delivery, while management explicitly warns against multiplying day rates by 365 before full deployment. New-vessel clearance, dry docking and charter conversion still matter. The August auditor announcement is for internal/secretarial appointments, not a statutory auditor resignation. [SMARCH](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/ABSMARINE_19032026172801_IntimationasperReg 30.pdf) [SAPRIL](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/ABSMARINE_09042026193720_IntimationtoNSEreg 30.pdf) [SCONTRACT](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/ABSMARINE_19062026165449_Intimationfornewcontract.pdf) [SAUD](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/ABSMARINE_19082026181151_IntimationforBoardMeetingasperReg 30.pdf) [SCALL](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/ABSMARINE_08062026131212_Intimationontranscriptofmeeting.pdf)
EXEC.contrary_evidence: Completed acquisitions and contract wins coexist with delays, clearance and off-hire risk; full-year day-rate multiplication is misleading.

REV.reason: Four-year consolidated statements establish comparable FY23–26 sales CAGR of 41.95%. Epsom was already consolidated and 78.18% owned; purchases of vessels expand assets, not purchased operating-business revenue. Older standalone history is kept separate rather than manufacturing a five-year group CAGR. [S24](https://absmarine.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/ABS-Annual-Report-2024.pdf) [S25](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/annual_reports/SME_AR_27749_ABSMARINE_2024_2025_A_5789022_26082025205957.pdf) [S26](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/annual_reports/SME_AR_30522_ABSMARINE_2025_2026_A_4942091_22082026195020.pdf) [SIPO](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/emerge/corporates/content/ABSMarine_PROSP.pdf) Framework short-history cap 8 applies; no trajectory uplift over this cap.
REV.contrary_evidence: Management guides only 10% FY27 growth and owned fleet growth requires capital; historical 41.95% is not the forecast.

CASH.reason: Three-year CFO/PAT after removing identified bank financing is 1.474 x. Further excluding FY26 related-dues expansion and the translation-reserve adjustment leaves₹139.58 cr, still above groupPAT. This is a sensitivity, not a proven reclassification of every related balance. Fleet capex consumes much more cash than depreciation; free cash remains negative during expansion. [S24](https://absmarine.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/ABS-Annual-Report-2024.pdf) [S25](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/annual_reports/SME_AR_27749_ABSMARINE_2024_2025_A_5789022_26082025205957.pdf) [S26](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/annual_reports/SME_AR_30522_ABSMARINE_2025_2026_A_4942091_22082026195020.pdf)
CASH.contrary_evidence: Strong adjusted FY26 conversion contrasts with large negative post-capex/interest cash and unsettled related balances.

EARN.reason: Core EBITDA/EBIT have grown strongly, but tonnage-tax adoption and a shift from written-down-value depreciation wording to straight-line depreciation affect comparability. The later audited annual ownerPAT₹79.9977 cr supports EPS₹32.59; the July₹81.5933 cr statement does not. The model uses economic depreciation and conservative cash taxes rather than simply compounding headlineEPS. [S25](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/annual_reports/SME_AR_27749_ABSMARINE_2024_2025_A_5789022_26082025205957.pdf) [S26](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/annual_reports/SME_AR_30522_ABSMARINE_2025_2026_A_4942091_22082026195020.pdf) [SCLARIFY](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/ABSMARINE_17072026184933_ReplytoNSEforresubmissionoffinancialresultsconsolidatedXBRL.pdf) [SCALL](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/ABSMARINE_08062026131212_Intimationontranscriptofmeeting.pdf)
EARN.contrary_evidence: Owner PAT and EPS rose sharply, but depreciation-method and tonnage-tax changes reduce comparability.

R.reason: Conditional base 7.68% less 15% hurdle falls between−10 and−7 pp.

D.reason: Severe operating/collection stress has₹387.09 cr unmet funding and uncertain recovery; no funded rescue assumed. Evidence confidence Medium concerns the documented leverage, concentrated demand and explicit cash stress; it is not confidence in predicting bankruptcy or a precise liquidation recovery. Recovery/forecast uncertainty remains high.

P.reason: Current price exceeds 15% hurdle entry by 38.95%; growth/multiple and replacement misses undermine return.

L.reason: L7: starting 9 for 0.736 theoretical sessions at 5% participation; deduct one for the 500-share lot (₹140,725), and one for concentrated participant breadth, SME trading caution, price volatility and unobserved live depth together. These execution risks are one combined judgment, not separate repeated deductions. REG1 EOD19 October, effective21 October, flags fewer than100 unique PANs in30 days, SME not regularly traded and high–low variation above150% in12 months. This does not mean zero-trade days: all60 sampled sessions have transactions. Current SM and20% band are observed. No match in the dated named ASM/ESM/GSM lists is not blanket clearance. Broker access, spread and sell-side queue remain execution-time conditions.

At the verified ₹281.45 close on 19 October, the corrected conditional model implies 7.68% base and 24.10% bull five-year returns, before personal taxes and after assumed 1% entry/exit friction. Model correction dated20 October2026: opening obligations and terminal claims have been reconciled separately from new forecast expenses. Reported historical financial statements are unchanged. The corrected scenario values are in section10.

sections.title: Research Header, Gates and Data Confidence
sections.text: ABS Marine Services Limited, NSE SME ABSMARINE, ISIN INE0QRV01016. Statutory consolidation includes wholly owned Singapore operations and 78.18%-owned Epsom. Chairman P.B.Narayanan owns the remaining 21.82% of Epsom. Oceandeep is a related company outside that consolidation. Four years of group statements are shown, with older standalone records kept separate. Five-year horizon,15% nominal equity hurdle and₹5 lakh reference liquidity. [S26](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/annual_reports/SME_AR_30522_ABSMARINE_2025_2026_A_4942091_22082026195020.pdf) [SIPO](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/emerge/corporates/content/ABSMarine_PROSP.pdf) [SRECON] Current share reconciliation confirms 24,550,000 issued and listed shares, unchanged in the September quarter. The 19 October NSE bhavcopy confirms ISIN, SM series and 500-share market lot. [SRECON] [SM]

sections.title: Scorecard and Calculation Audit
sections.text: Canonical factors: GOV4, MOAT6, REV8, DUR6, CAP5, CASH6, BAL5, EXEC6, EARN6. REV originally 9 is corrected to 8 because four years of comparable consolidated statements cannot satisfy the framework’s full-history requirement. This is a methodology correction, not newly weaker revenue. BQS=0.20×4+0.20×6+0.12×8+0.10×6+0.12×5+0.10×6+0.08×5+0.08×6=5.64. GQS=0.40×8+0.20×6+0.15×6+0.15×5+0.10×6=6.65. Conditional R2, D2 and P3; L7 after explicit two-point execution haircut. IAS=.25×5.64+.35×2+.20×2+.10×3+.10×7=3.51; no reweighting. IAS is excluded from implementation ranking while the financing bridge is unresolved. D2 evidence confidence is Medium for the stress mechanism; forecast/recovery uncertainty remains high and no precise recovery is scored.

sections.title: Business Overview
sections.text: FY26 group revenue was₹319.1281 cr, group PAT₹80.7955 cr and owner PAT₹79.9977 cr. Charter hire supplies 74.4% of revenue; ship-management fees fell 4.7% year-on-year. The mix shift toward owned vessels improves margins but requires much more capital and debt. The rating analysis additionally combines Oceandeep, so its historical PAT/net-worth figures cannot replace statutory listed-group numbers. [S26](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/annual_reports/SME_AR_30522_ABSMARINE_2025_2026_A_4942091_22082026195020.pdf) [SCRA](https://www.crisil.com/mnt/winshare/Ratings/RatingList/RatingDocs/ABSMarineServicesLimited_June%2024_%202026_RR_398742.html)

sections.title: Moat / Industry Position
sections.text: Vessel specifications, compliance and established counterparties provide differentiation, but supply cycles and tender competition matter. Direct marine peer Seamec reports FY26 revenue₹952.46 cr, CFO₹321.30 cr and grossPPE/CWIP cash investment₹379.38 cr. Its scale, vessel mix and depreciation differ; strong sector earnings do not establish a transferable multiple. No peer premium or unverified vessel appraisal is used. [S26](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/annual_reports/SME_AR_30522_ABSMARINE_2025_2026_A_4942091_22082026195020.pdf) [SPEER](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/annual_reports/AR_30998_SEAMECLTD_2025_2026_A_4812143_01092026164348.pdf)

sections.title: Revenue Growth & Scale
sections.text: Group revenue grows₹111.5751/135.1568/179.8521/319.1281 cr overFY23–26, a 41.95% CAGR. Older IPO statements are standalone, so a five-year consolidated CAGR is ND. New vessels are capital investment rather than purchased-business revenue. Management guided only 10% FY27 growth because clearances, dry docks and charter starts limit the first-year contribution. [S24](https://absmarine.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/ABS-Annual-Report-2024.pdf) [S25](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/annual_reports/SME_AR_27749_ABSMARINE_2024_2025_A_5789022_26082025205957.pdf) [S26](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/annual_reports/SME_AR_30522_ABSMARINE_2025_2026_A_4942091_22082026195020.pdf) [SCALL](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/ABSMARINE_08062026131212_Intimationontranscriptofmeeting.pdf)

sections.title: Growth Quality & Reinvestment Runway
sections.text: Full-capital incremental NOPAT proxy is 18.0% with normalized 7% tax. Economic depreciation of₹45 cr lowers it to 16.2%; constant-margin returns are weaker. Fleet utilization, charter repricing and tonnage-tax adoption explain part of the increase. Existing physical assets cannot support perpetual growth without replacement and additional vessels. The model pays maintenance/replacement capex plus 1.5×incremental sales as growth capital afteryear 1. [S24](https://absmarine.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/ABS-Annual-Report-2024.pdf) [S26](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/annual_reports/SME_AR_30522_ABSMARINE_2025_2026_A_4942091_22082026195020.pdf) [SCALL](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/ABSMARINE_08062026131212_Intimationontranscriptofmeeting.pdf)

sections.title: Management, Governance & Execution
sections.text: The July 17 clarification adds minority profit₹0.7978 cr to group PAT and reports₹81.5933 cr. The later annual instead subtracts it to₹79.9977 cr, matching EPS₹32.59; the later annual is used. Related charter charges to Oceandeep are₹49.5992 cr, with₹20.7231 cr due. The June call did not numerically resolve a question about earlier charter income versus expense. The auditor opinions remain unmodified. August auditor appointments concern internal/secretarial roles, not a statutory resignation. [S26](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/annual_reports/SME_AR_30522_ABSMARINE_2025_2026_A_4942091_22082026195020.pdf) [SCLARIFY](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/ABSMARINE_17072026184933_ReplytoNSEforresubmissionoffinancialresultsconsolidatedXBRL.pdf) [SCALL](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/ABSMARINE_08062026131212_Intimationontranscriptofmeeting.pdf) [SAUD](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/ABSMARINE_19082026181151_IntimationforBoardMeetingasperReg30.pdf) The new governance exemption filing acknowledges that RPT Regulation 23 applies from 1 April 2025 despite specified SME exemptions. Zero investor grievances in the quarter do not establish clean governance. [SGOV] [SGRIEV] Fresh post-annual check: shareholders approved the CMD term from16 September2026 to15 September2031. The10 September voting record reports15,721,500 promoter-group shares out of24,550,000, or64.04%; this is dated ownership, not a September30 shareholding or pledge clearance. Interested promoter votes were excluded from the Oceandeep/Epsom RPT resolutions. The April declaration says no encumbrance was created duringFY26, not that no encumbrance exists today. The FY26 PCS SDD certificate reports61 required events captured and no reported noncompliance within its scope. These disclosures do not erase the accounting and connected-party concerns. [SMD] [SVOTE] [SPLEDGE] [SSDD]

sections.title: Financial Forensics
sections.text: Reported FY26 CFO₹167.6222 cr explicitly includes₹6.4011 cr of additional short-term borrowings. Removing bank financing across three years gives CFO/PAT1.474 x. Excluding all FY26 related-dues expansion and translation adjustment as a further sensitivity leaves₹139.58 cr. This does not prove all related balances are financing. GrossPPE and capital-advance spending totals₹404.1526 cr. Receivables older than six months are₹22.1436 cr; collection quality still matters. [S24](https://absmarine.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/ABS-Annual-Report-2024.pdf) [S25](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/annual_reports/SME_AR_27749_ABSMARINE_2024_2025_A_5789022_26082025205957.pdf) [S26](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/annual_reports/SME_AR_30522_ABSMARINE_2025_2026_A_4942091_22082026195020.pdf) The borrowing-line removal is a supplementary classification sensitivity, not proof every change is an external cash draw: short-term balances can include current maturities. Reported CFO must not be equated with owner free cash. After financing-line removal, gross capital expenditure and financing-classified interest, FY26 residual cash is −₹273.7874 cr. FY24 comparative PAT and cash-flow reclassifications are retained in the financial-history notes rather than silently mixed.

sections.title: Valuation & Market Expectations
sections.text:
The whole-equity model starts with₹57.055 cr liquid assets after identified liens and₹377.2223 cr debt. Hades/Artemis was deliveredMarch 19, so charging the call’s combinedUS$15 m for both new vessels again would double count. Remaining post-March cash purchase and matching dedicated loan are modeled at₹45 cr, with₹30–60 cr sensitivities; exact allocation is not claimed. Base assumptions are 10% growth then 8%,46% EBITDA margin,₹45 crreplacement capex rising 3%, growth capex, annual principal payments and 7% positive-PBT cash tax with a floor. Retained cash is credited once; debt and a 3.3% NCI haircut are deducted once. Conditional 15% hurdle entry is₹202.56. [S26](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/annual_reports/SME_AR_30522_ABSMARINE_2025_2026_A_4942091_22082026195020.pdf) [SMARCH](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/ABSMARINE_19032026172801_IntimationasperReg 30.pdf) [SAPRIL](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/ABSMARINE_09042026193720_IntimationtoNSEreg 30.pdf) [SCALL](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/ABSMARINE_08062026131212_Intimationontranscriptofmeeting.pdf) Updated price is ₹281.45, market capitalization ₹690.9597 cr and headline owner P/E 8.64×. After correcting opening obligations and terminal claims, base IRR is 7.68% and bull to 24.10%; the corrected conditional 15% hurdle entry is ₹202.56. Price is about 38.95% above that entry. It is not a verified intrinsic value. Higher growth is not automatically better: 13% post-first-year growth creates a ₹64.25 crore funding gap under the tested reinvestment assumptions.

Model correction, 20 October 2026: this changes our cash-flow/terminal-claim treatment, not the issuer’s reported history. Pay ₹1.4736 crore statutory dues and ₹0.1468 crore current employee provision once in year1. The ₹3.4824 crore net advance-tax asset remains excluded, and there is no opening net income-tax payable. Retain ₹1.281 crore noncurrent employee provision and ₹0.0075 crore rental deposit as terminal group claims. Related charter/operating dues, accrued expenses, other payables and customer advances total ₹29.2338 crore. These are explicitly retained as a constant operating liability stock, with invoices paid and replaced by normal accruals; no incremental payable credit is assumed. Their unusually large connected-party component makes rollover conditional, not assured. The accelerated-settlement stress pays ₹29.1338 crore once and keeps only ₹0.1 crore customer advances; it removes the ₹20.7231 crore Oceandeep payment already embedded in bear before charging the broader settlement. Corrected linked scenarios: Base: illustrative terminal price ₹415.65; peak funding gap ₹0.0000 crore; conditional IRR 7.68%. Bull: illustrative terminal price ₹845.04; peak funding gap ₹0.0000 crore; conditional IRR 24.10%. Bear: illustrative terminal price ₹0.00; peak funding gap ₹387.0883 crore; no investable IRR. [S26]

sections.title: Bear Case & Permanent-Loss Path
sections.text: Bear assumptions link 25% sales loss to 30% then 35% EBITDA margins,45 extra collection days,10% receivable loss, settlement of Oceandeep dues, a customs claim and₹20 crrepairs/remediation. Maintenance and scheduled debt service continue; discretionary growth investment stops. The resulting₹387.09 crshortfall has no verified remedy. No investable bear IRR is shown. Internal guarantees of₹308.8008 cr reconcile to₹25.9658 cr given to Epsom plus₹282.8350 cr received from Epsom and are not counted again as external debt. The printed contingent-table subtotal remains inconsistent. [S26](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/annual_reports/SME_AR_30522_ABSMARINE_2025_2026_A_4942091_22082026195020.pdf)

sections.title: 5× / 10× Feasibility
sections.text: At ₹281.45, five-year 5×/10× prices are ₹1407.25/₹2814.50, requiring 38.0%/58.5% annual price appreciation. At 10× owner earnings and model terminal shares 2.48584 cr, those prices require approximately ₹349.82/₹699.64 cr owner earnings before cash/debt adjustments, versus FY26₹80.0 cr. A feasible path needs additional funded vessels, utilization and favorable renewal rates without large dilution; it is not supported by the base case. [SM] [S26]

These execution risks are one combined judgment, not separate repeated deductions. REG1 EOD19 October, effective21 October, flags fewer than100 unique PANs in30 days, SME not regularly traded and high–low variation above150% in12 months. This does not mean zero-trade days: all60 sampled sessions have transactions. Current SM and20% band are observed. No match in the dated named ASM/ESM/GSM lists is not blanket clearance. sections.title: Final Classification & Conditional Action
sections.text: Growth with capital, governance and funding cautions. BQS5.64/GQS6.65 do not meet high-quality-compounder thresholds. The lower dated quote improves conditional base return to 7.68%, still below the 15% hurdle. D2 reflects a supported severe permanent-loss path with uncertain recovery, not a prediction of default. Current liquidity is assessed conditionally at L7; execution-time checks still apply. No buy recommendation or portfolio sizing is made.

sections.title: Sources, Assumptions & Open Questions
sections.text: Primary annuals, IPO statements, vessel-delivery and charter filings, the June call, July clarification and exchange data support the record. Four-year consolidated history is not extended with unmatched standalone figures. Bank financing is separated from reported CFO. The guarantee reconciliation prevents double counting. The post-March cash bridge and NCI allocation remain bounded assumptions, not newly audited balances. FY25 uses written-down-value depreciation wording whileFY26 uses straight-line; the model therefore applies economic replacement spending. Prior archive remains unchanged. This update explicitly corrects REV and withdraws the old L8 because a mixture of 23 exchange sessions and 58 proxy observations did not meet the 60-session definition. Current half-year operating results, actual post-March cash/debt movements, vessel-level maintenance and independent distress values remain open. The call’s forward statements are management claims, and bridge, tax, terminal multiple and replacement costs are analyst assumptions. Post-annual announcement index reviewed through20 October, with pertinent governance, capital and price-query filings read. No later financial balance sheet is substituted for the March model starting point. The April delivery disclosure still does not establish actual consideration/loan draw, so the funding bridge remains conditional rather than silently upgraded.

evidence.claim: Unmodified opinions and affirmative audit-trail reporting coexist with material reporting inconsistencies. July clarification adds positive minority profit, while the later annual correctly subtracts it. Cash-flow presentation includes bank financing, and the contingent-guarantee subtotal does not add. Oceandeep is outside the statutory group and related charter economics remain incompletely reconciled. These concerns do not establish intent or diversion. [S26](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/annual_reports/SME_AR_30522_ABSMARINE_2025_2026_A_4942091_22082026195020.pdf) [S25](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/annual_reports/SME_AR_27749_ABSMARINE_2024_2025_A_5789022_26082025205957.pdf) [SCLARIFY](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/ABSMARINE_17072026184933_ReplytoNSEforresubmissionoffinancialresultsconsolidatedXBRL.pdf) [SCALL](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/ABSMARINE_08062026131212_Intimationontranscriptofmeeting.pdf)
evidence.locator: annual statements and claim-specific notes; detailed history/model retained
evidence.limitation: Unmodified audit is favorable counterevidence; reporting errors do not prove intentional diversion.

evidence.claim: Normalized company-level incremental NOPAT proxy18.0% falls to16.2% with₹45cr economic depreciation. Constant25–35%margins yield weaker returns. Pricing, tax change and new fleet utilization confound attribution to new capital; mixed economics around/beyond the12–16%cost range support5, not a high-return extrapolation. [S24](https://absmarine.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/ABS-Annual-Report-2024.pdf) [S26](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/annual_reports/SME_AR_30522_ABSMARINE_2025_2026_A_4942091_22082026195020.pdf) [SCALL](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/ABSMARINE_08062026131212_Intimationontranscriptofmeeting.pdf)
evidence.locator: annual statements and claim-specific notes; detailed history/model retained
evidence.limitation: Normalized incremental return18.0% looks strong but constant-margin returns9.45–13.23% may not exceed assumed12–16% cost.
evidence.formula: (113.698−14.7969)×0.93/(637.314−126.4828)=18.0056%; economic depreciation45 sensitivity reduces endpoint EBIT9.6661.

evidence.claim: Borrowings rise to₹377.22cr versus common equity₹311.08cr. Mortgage, receivable escrow and liens limit liquidity flexibility. Internal guarantees reconcile to debt already consolidated and are not added again. The normal model is funded under explicit post-March acquisition/loan bounds, but a severe utilization/collection stress is not. [S26](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/annual_reports/SME_AR_30522_ABSMARINE_2025_2026_A_4942091_22082026195020.pdf) [SCRA](https://www.crisil.com/mnt/winshare/Ratings/RatingList/RatingDocs/ABSMarineServicesLimited_June%2024_%202026_RR_398742.html)
evidence.locator: annual statements and claim-specific notes; detailed history/model retained
evidence.limitation: CRISIL upgrade is favorable but covers a broader group; it does not eliminate listed-group debt and stress shortfall.

evidence.claim: Specialized vessels, regulatory qualification and charter relationships support switching friction. Tender competition, charter-rate cyclicality and concentrated counterparties prevent an assumption of permanent pricing power. The current profit mix is increasingly asset-intensive vessel ownership rather than only management fees. [S26](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/annual_reports/SME_AR_30522_ABSMARINE_2025_2026_A_4942091_22082026195020.pdf) [SCONTRACT](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/ABSMARINE_19062026165449_Intimationfornewcontract.pdf)
evidence.locator: annual statements and claim-specific notes; detailed history/model retained
evidence.limitation: Concentrated customers and tender renewals limit sustained pricing power despite technical qualifications.

evidence.claim: Several multi-year charters provide near-term visibility. Artemis has a five-year firm contract, but extension options belong to the charterer. Offshore spending, vessel availability, renewal rates and ageing assets remain cyclical; long contracts do not eliminate maintenance or debt service. [S26](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/annual_reports/SME_AR_30522_ABSMARINE_2025_2026_A_4942091_22082026195020.pdf) [SCONTRACT](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/ABSMARINE_19062026165449_Intimationfornewcontract.pdf) [SCALL](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/ABSMARINE_08062026131212_Intimationontranscriptofmeeting.pdf)
evidence.locator: annual statements and claim-specific notes; detailed history/model retained
evidence.limitation: Charterer-controlled extension options and dry-dock/off-hire risk prevent treating the visible term as perpetual.

evidence.claim: Fleet purchases and the Artemis charter demonstrate delivery, while management explicitly warns against multiplying day rates by365 before full deployment. New-vessel clearance, dry docking and charter conversion still matter. The August auditor announcement is for internal/secretarial appointments, not a statutory auditor resignation. evidence.locator: annual statements and claim-specific notes; detailed history/model retained
evidence.limitation: Completed acquisitions and contract wins coexist with delays, clearance and off-hire risk; full-year day-rate multiplication is misleading.

evidence.claim: Model correction, 20 October 2026: this changes our cash-flow/terminal-claim treatment, not the issuer’s reported history. Pay ₹1.4736 crore statutory dues and ₹0.1468 crore current employee provision once in year1. The ₹3.4824 crore net advance-tax asset remains excluded, and there is no opening net income-tax payable. Retain ₹1.281 crore noncurrent employee provision and ₹0.0075 crore rental deposit as terminal group claims. Related charter/operating dues, accrued expenses, other payables and customer advances total ₹29.2338 crore. These are explicitly retained as a constant operating liability stock, with invoices paid and replaced by normal accruals; no incremental payable credit is assumed. Their unusually large connected-party component makes rollover conditional, not assured. The accelerated-settlement stress pays ₹29.1338 crore once and keeps only ₹0.1 crore customer advances; it removes the ₹20.7231 crore Oceandeep payment already embedded in bear before charging the broader settlement. Corrected linked scenarios: Base: illustrative terminal price ₹415.65; peak funding gap ₹0.0000 crore; conditional IRR 7.68%. Bull: illustrative terminal price ₹845.04; peak funding gap ₹0.0000 crore; conditional IRR 24.10%. Bear: illustrative terminal price ₹0.00; peak funding gap ₹387.0883 crore; no investable IRR.
evidence.locator: Consolidated annual report, printed pages132–138, notes4,5,8,9,12
evidence.scope: Analyst forward model, same historical/quote cutoff
evidence.limitation: Settlement timing, normal operating-stock replacement and tax-credit usability remain explicit assumptions; accelerated settlement and no-credit cases are separate sensitivities.
evidence.formula: Y1 settlement=1.4736+0.1468=1.6204. Terminal group claim=1.281+0.0075=1.2885. Annual draw=min(remaining9.433 headroom, cash needed including same-year draw interest); no immediate tax shield on new same-year draw. Equity=(EV+cash−20 reserve−debt−1.2885)×0.967, floored at0. IRR=(terminal price×0.99/(281.45×1.01))^(1/5)−1 only when funded.

evidence.claim: BQS, GQS, R/D/P scores, gate states and ranking eligibility are unchanged after reassessment.
